thread:
sam: Heads-up — I'm the deploy owner for the runtime bump, starting rollout at 16:10 PT (canary -> 50% -> 100%, 5m ramps). Smoke checklist below, ping here if you spot anything unusual.
ops-bot: Deploy job kicked off. Canary slice created: canary-2026-03-16-10. Instances: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0b2c3d4e. Logs streaming: https://logs.redwood.example/canary-2026-03-16-10
maya: Ack. I'll run the functional smoke on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings once canary is up.
jordan: I'll watch p99 latency, error-rate, and per-model tokenization errors. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/r/rollouts
lee: Rollback plan reminder: use `./deploy rollback --to=2026-02-runtime` or toggle the console rollback button. Drains take ~30s per pod. If error-rate >0.5% or p99 >2x baseline for 2 consecutive windows, initiate rollback.
anita: Running quick smoke commands now:
```bash
# chat send
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hi"}]}' | jq 
# embeddings
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"test"}' | jq
```
maya: Smoke results (canary): chat OK, response sanity checks pass. Embeddings OK. Latency: chat p95 ~120ms (baseline 95ms). No 5xxs observed. :white_check_mark:
jordan: Observed 3 transient 500s from i-0b2c3d4e right after step1 ramp; they look tied to a single host's disk pressure. Error-rate back to baseline after 30s. I'll cordon and restart that host if it repeats.
sam: Thanks — cordon host if it reappears. If it's a one-off, continue rollout. Anyone on logs/traces for that host?
lee: I'll take it if it repeats. For now, continue to 50%. Keep an eye on KV cache hit-rate too (we saw small drop during last bump).
ops-bot: Canary -> 50% at 16:15. Health checks: all green. Metrics: p99 1.1x baseline, error-rate 0.03%.
anita: Prep note: rollback artifact `release-2026-02-runtime.tar.gz` is ready in /releases and the DB migrations are reversible. Team lead signoff present.
sam: OK moving to 100% in ~10m if no regressions. Thanks all for quick checks — please post here if you see anything odd during the final ramp. :rocket:
